brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build fit checks only; per instructions configurator does not verify strength/load ratings. No 50 kg rating can be claimed. Build is geometrically clear (meshClash clear).

Two notch drawer frames placed at -1,1,0 and 1,-1,0 (notch:0#-1,1#notch0 and notch:0#1,-1#notch4, hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf). Drawer inserts themselves not offered (find_sockets drawer 0), so frames present but not complete drawer units.

finish.summary: Build is geometrically verified (check_build ok, meshClash clear) but cannot be rated for 50 kg as configurator checks fit only. Two drawer frames are installed to provide drawer locations; drawer inserts not available in current socket offers.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
